adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new loop over `event.destinationCalendar` does `else { const destinationCalendarCredentials = this.calendarCredentials.filter((c) => c.type === destination.integration); createdEvents = createdEvents.concat(await Promise.all(destinationCalendarCredentials.map(async (c) => await createEvent(c, event)))); }` for any destination calendar entry missing `credentialId`. Since `this.calendarCredentials` are the EventManager’s loaded credentials (organizer context), each legacy co-host `DestinationCalendar` without `credentialId` will re-run creation across the organizer’s matching credentials, causing duplicate event creation and potential N×M fan-out when multiple such destinations exist. This duplication is directly introduced by moving the “no credentialId” fallback inside the per-destination loop.
